Vanessa / team —

Quick take after a short pass on the CSV:
- 1,000 sustained qps at ~500 tokens is feasible but depends on model selection and quantization. With a 16-GPU reserved pool (NVIDIA A100 equivalence), we should be able to stay < 300ms p99 using our optimized kernels and batching; an 8-GPU pool will be tighter — expect p99 in the 320–450ms range depending on sequence variance.
- Bursts to 1.5k qps are OK if we provision a small burst pool or enable our transient autoscale policy for short windows; recommend a 20% headroom config and KV cache warmup before the big batch window.
- Immediate asks for the pre-call: sample payload (we have it), a rough TTL for KV cache (they should set predictable prefixes where possible), and an example of worst-case sequence length.

I'll prepare a 1-page capacity checklist and bring one infra engineer to the Wed 08:30am PST call. Attached is a short checklist we use for sizing.

Cheers,
